headline: Small intestine: its 3 parts in order
body:
Duodenum: first, about 10 inches
Jejunum: middle, about 8 feet
Ileum: last and longest section

headline: You make up to 1.5 liters of saliva a day
stat_note: upper end of daily saliva in most adults
body: Salivary glands make about 0.5 to 1.5 liters (2 to 6.3 cups) a day. Saliva is 99% water; the rest is proteins and electrolytes.

headline: Your tongue is run by 8 pairs of muscles
body: Extrinsic muscles move the tongue; intrinsic muscles change its shape. All get the hypoglossal nerve (CN XII) except palatoglossus (CN X).
source: Source: Kenhub, Muscles of the tongue
